title: SOP approval readiness
summary: Whether the procedure can be carried out as written, with every gap listed by step. Two dry runs with different briefs, then safety, QC and document control checks. The process owner and the quality or safety approver sign; Sasha records the approval and never grants it.

outcome.label: Can be carried out as written

checkpoint.role: Process owner and quality or safety approver

notes: Sasha records the approval and never grants it.
For high-stakes procedures, confirm someone walked through it physically.
The dry runs are simulated on paper; nothing was carried out.

config.instructions: List each procedure step in order.

fields.name: action
fields.label: Action
fields.description: What the step says to do

fields.name: materials
fields.label: Materials
fields.description: Materials and equipment the step uses

fields.name: quantities_settings
fields.label: Quantities and settings
fields.description: Quantities, settings, durations and tolerances the step gives

fields.name: warning_before
fields.label: Warning before the step
fields.description: Whether a hazard warning appears before this step

fields.name: qc_check
fields.label: QC check
fields.description: The QC check at this step, if any

config.persona: a new hire holding only the listed materials and the text
config.task: Carry out the procedure from start to finish using only the listed materials and the text.
rules: log every point where you must guess: a missing quantity, setting, unit, duration or tolerance; an undefined term; an unclear actor; a judgment call with no criterion

config.task: Carry out the procedure from start to finish as written, noting where your experience fills a gap the text leaves.
rules: log every point where you must guess: a missing quantity, setting, unit, duration or tolerance; an undefined term; an unclear actor; a judgment call with no criterion

checklist.label: Warnings before their steps
checklist.question: Does each hazard have a warning placed before the step it applies to (not after)?

checklist.label: Protective equipment
checklist.question: Is the protective equipment for each hazard stated?

checklist.label: Stop conditions
checklist.question: Are the conditions that mean stop stated?

checklist.label: Disposal
checklist.question: Is disposal of waste and materials covered?

config.instructions: Apply these checks only to steps with a QC check; mark the other steps not_applicable.

checklist.label: Numeric acceptance criterion
checklist.question: Does the QC check have a numeric acceptance criterion?

checklist.label: Failure path
checklist.question: Does it say what to do when the check fails?

checklist.label: Record
checklist.question: Does it name the record to keep?

checklist.label: Version
checklist.question: Is there a version or revision number?

checklist.label: Effective and review dates
checklist.question: Are the effective date and the next review date stated?

checklist.label: Current references
checklist.question: Are the references current and complete?

checklist.label: Change log
checklist.question: Is there a change log or revision history?

config.instructions: Record the approval. Sasha records it and never grants it. The process owner and the quality or safety approver each sign, as themselves; the approval is final only once both have signed.
